home.title: My barbershop

home.ownShopTitle: Do you have your own barbershop?
home.ownShopText: Open it on Charles or work independently with your own schedule.

type.label: Type

form.name: Name
form.addressHint: As your clients will see it.

form.locationDenied: Without location permission we can't place your barbershop. Turn it on in settings.
form.locationOutside: For now the barbershop must be in Peru.
form.created: Done! Your barbershop was created and is under review.

statusForm.title: Opening status

services.empty: You have no services yet. Create the first one so people can book you.

form.name: Service name
form.deleteMessage: It will no longer be bookable. Existing bookings are kept.
form.invalidPrice: Enter a price greater than 0, for example 25 or 25.50.

barbers.title: Barbers
barbers.empty: No barbers yet. Add your team or register yourself.
barbers.independentLimit: An independent barber has a single active barber.

form.inviteHint: We'll send a code to that email. The account must exist in Charles.

members.title: Managers
members.removeMessage: They will no longer manage this barbershop.

hours.inheritHint: If you turn it off, the barber will have their own hours.

blocks.deleteMessage: That time will be bookable again.

blocks.overlaps_other: That block overlaps {{count}} active bookings. Handle them first or choose another time.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.asBarber: You're invited as a barber ({{name}}) to {{shop}}

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a Peruvian mobile: 9 digits starting with 9.

document.title: Owner's document
document.createHint: RUC or DNI of the person responsible for the business. You can add it now or later, but it's required to send the barbershop to review.
document.editHint: For security we only show the last digits. Enter a new one only if you want to change it.
document.rucInvalid: That RUC is not valid. Check the numbers.
document.serverInvalid: That document number is not valid. Check it.

review.noNotes: Check your barbershop details and send it again.
review.approved: Your barbershop is approved and published.

photos.denied: Without permission we can't access your photos. Turn it on in the phone settings.
photos.unavailable: Uploading photos arrives with the next version of the app.

gallery.deleteMessage: It will no longer show in the gallery. This can't be undone.
gallery.limit: Up to 60 photos per barber and 6 highlighted.
